# Classic Shop - Phòng Tranh & Cá Cảnh Phước Sang

> > An online aquarium fish and art paintings retailer offering ornamental fish varieties, aquarium accessories, and Vietnamese artwork from Thanh Hóa, Vietnam.

Classic Shop (cacanh24.com) is a Vietnamese e-commerce business specializing in premium aquarium supplies and fine art paintings. The store features popular fish species like Betta, Koi, and Neon fish, along with aquatic equipment from brands like Boyu and Sobo.

## Key Topics

- Ornamental Fish
- Aquarium Accessories
- Betta Fish
- Koi Fish
- Art Paintings
- Aquarium Tanks
- Aquatic Equipment
- Boyu Products
- Vietnamese Art
- Pet Supplies
- Aquarium Shop
- Home Decor
- Thanh Hóa Vietnam
- E-commerce

## Shop & Products

- [Cửa hàng](https://cacanh24.com/cua-hang): Main product catalog and shop page featuring aquarium supplies
- [Cá Cảnh](https://cacanh24.com/danh-muc/ca-canh): Ornamental fish category catalog with Betta, 7-color fish, Koi, and other aquatic species
- [Phụ Kiện](https://cacanh24.com/danh-muc/phu-kien): Aquarium accessories and equipment catalog including Boyu, Sobo, and Keyrsin products
- [Tranh Mỹ Thuật](https://cacanh24.com/danh-muc/tranh-my-thuat): Art paintings collection featuring Vietnamese oil paintings and home decor artwork
